svg.title: BIPIA construct acceptance combinations needed for a 181-case frame
svg.desc: At least 57 of 76 construct-review cases must be accepted, including at least 31 code cases and 7 unknown-sentinel cases.
svg.text: The 19-row reserve does not remove either construct dependency
Blue combinations can supply 57 construct cases; gray combinations cannot
Sharp condition: accepted code + accepted sentinel >= 57. Current approvals: 0/76.
